Customizable catering, beverage, and entertainment options are available to enhance the experience.

quotes.author: Sean Boren
quotes.text: The entire experience was top notch. Boat has a great setup with a large indoors area with multiple tables and a bar. There is a large outside deck for dancing and socializing. Perfect event space!

quotes.author: Ivana R
quotes.text: Wow, what an experience! I have no words to describe what a great time we had on the yacht! I received a message from every single guest that they never experienced something this special before.

quotes.author: Christy Wendte
quotes.text: We hosted visiting executives in San Diego and took them on a Sunset Dinner cruise. The experience was exceptional beyond our expectations. The service, from start to finish, was impeccable.

quotes.author: Janice Pilapil
quotes.text: The crew was amazing and super flexible! The yacht was in great condition and actually exceeded my expectations. Would rent again!

The entire experience was top notch. Boat has a great set up with a large indoors area with multiple tables and a bar and area to dance. There is a large outside area on top of the boat with bar tables and tons of space to dance and enjoy the outside. The captain did a great job of touring the bay with a real close flyby of under the Midway. Staff was very helpful and took care of everything. We also purchased one of their charcuterie boards and it was pretty amazing. Highly recommend if you're looking for a large party on the water!

We were very excited to host our event with Legacy Cruises, as it looked to be one of the most updated boats to host an event on in the marina.. and it did not disappoint! The staff was incredibly helpful from the planning to day of execution and the boat itself was perfect for a luxury event. We will definitely be working with Legacy Cruises again!
